newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans steady in medium volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans steady in medium volume.

text.p: Argentine spot cash soybeans were flat in middling volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices underpinned by steady crusher buying, traders said.

Forward soybean trade was slow and May prices unchanged. Sunflower seed was a similar story to soy, with spot sunseed steady to firmer in average turnover. But March sunseed slipped, depressed by lower international prices. Cash wheat trade was very slow, with prices unchanged or slightly lower. The ports are full shipping out the harvest. April maize drifted donwards in slow trade, with good weather and slow export sales.
